analysis_cautions: Continuous densities approximate rounded time measurements.
These are successive geyser measurements; a random split is a descriptive density benchmark, not a validated forecasting design. Check dependence before claiming independent-sample inference.
Do not invent external true cluster labels.
faithful.citation: R Core Team, datasets package, faithful; source credited to W. Hardle. Hardle (1991), Smoothing Techniques: With Implementation in S.
documentation_cautions: Eruption durations are heavily rounded, with many multiples of five seconds. Preserve the released values.
Different published versions of the geyser data exist; this is R datasets::faithful with 272 rows.

features.description: Waiting time to the next eruption
features.name: waiting

faithful.license_note: R source repository reports GPL-2.0; the faithful manual does not state a separate dataset-specific license.
faithful.source_type: R source, obtained through the read-only wch/r-source mirror of https://svn.r-project.org/R/
faithful.table_conversion: Parsed the two numeric vectors from R source without executing R; preserved row order and literal precision.
faithful.title: Old Faithful Geyser Data

seeds.citation: Charytanowicz, M., Niewczas, J., Kulczycki, P., Kowalski, P., and Lukasik, S. (2010). Seeds [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C5H30K.
seeds.collection: Geometric measurements from soft X-ray images of kernels from experimental wheat fields in Lublin, Poland; 70 randomly selected kernels per variety.

labels.code_to_name_mapping: Not explicitly stated in the consulted UCI page; do not infer names solely from ordering.
labels.name: class

metadata_based_feature_choice.reason: The source defines compactness = 4*pi*area/perimeter^2, so the seven-coordinate vector contains a derived feature and is approximately confined to a lower-dimensional surface after measurement rounding.
metadata_based_feature_choice.recommendation: For a continuous-density benchmark, omit compactness a priori, leaving six measurement features. Keep all original fields in the raw file and CSV.

seeds.table_conversion: Split arbitrary whitespace into eight fields, add names, retain every numerical literal and row. Using a single tab delimiter would misparse some rows.
seeds.title: Seeds

evaluation_requirements: Split observations before fitting any scaling, rotation, feature selection, or other learned preprocessing.
Use the same held-out observations and training-only preprocessing for every method.
Return log densities to a common coordinate system with the proper Jacobian.
Keep Seeds class labels out of fitting, initialization, and model selection; use them only for external evaluation if labels are treated as unavailable.
These small benchmarks are illustrations; neither alone establishes a substantive new scientific application.
processing: Only format conversion and integrity checks. Original numerical literals and row order retained. No imputation, filtering, jitter, standardization, log transform, or fitted preprocessing.
selection_basis: Chosen before fitting: a small bivariate benchmark and a wheat morphology benchmark with observed variety labels. No outcome-driven selection.
